spans.s:
n. (-कं)
1 A flock of parrots.
2 Sorrowfulness.
E.
शुक a parrot, अञ् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं)
Acid, acetic.
E.
शुक्त vinegar, अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Acid, acetic.
2 Relating to a pearl, &c.
E.
शुक्त or शुक्ति, and ठक् aff.

n. (-यं)
A pearl.
E.
शुक्ति a pearl-oyster, ढक् aff.; also from शुक्तिका with the same, शौक्तिकेय.

m. (-यः)
A sort of poison.
E.
शुक्लिक a country, ढक् aff.: according to some it is the venom of a snake of the Amphisbœna kind.

n. (-क्ल्यं)
Whiteness.
E.
शुक्ल white, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Hoggish, swinish.
2 Relating to a hog.
E.
सूकर a hog, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A hunter.
E.
सूकर a boar, and ठक् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Facility, ease of effecting any thing.
2 Easy and extempore composition, or preparation of food or medicine.
3 Hoggishness, swinishness, the condition or qualities of a hog.
E.
सुकर doing easily, or सूकर a hog, &c., aff. ष्यञ्.

Delicacy, tenderness.
E.
सुकुमार, and ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-क्ष्म्यं)
Minuteness, subtility.
E.
सूक्ष्म small, fine, ष्यञ् aff.
